profile.headline: Hyperion  Financial Planning, Reporting and Consolidations
profile.summary: A Hyperion Certified Developer offering 15 years of experience in the design and development of Planning and Essbase databases for the banking, telecom and healthcare insurance industries.  Strengths include extensive knowledge of OLAP, data warehouse databases and ETL technologies. Skilled at the installation and configuration of Oracle EPM environments 9.3 through 11.1.2.2, patch installation, troubleshooting, infrastructure support, change control, performance tuning, system administration in both UNIX and Windows environments.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Oracle EPM Hyperion System versions 9.3, 11.1.1.3, 11.1.2.2 – Planned and coordinated the installation of multiple environments. Extensive hands on experience with all aspects of installation and configuration including Weblogic application server, HTTP web server, Shared Services security interfaces to active directory. Coordinated the backup and recovery, data loading, rules scripting, automation, optimization and front end deployment process within the IT organization.

•	Hyperion Financial Management – Participated in the analysis, design and customization of metadata to support security, multiple currencies and cash flow. Responsible for maintenance of business rules through multiple reorganizations, mergers and acquisitions; Created data extraction, transformation and load rules to support consolidation of financial data from multiple GL systems. 

•	Planning and Essbase – Created two Planning Applications one for department expense budgeting and forecasting, the other for project revenue and expense. Developed and maintained outline, complex business rules, calc scripts, web forms, smart lists, and task lists. Created an interface to automate the dimension updates using planning utilities. Developed load rules to load monthly actual, budget and forecast data. Developed and maintained multidimensional security interface inside application. Provided assistance to the user support team. Trained functional team and prepared technical and user documentation for the application.
